people.name: Charles Frederick Worth
people.extract: Charles Frederick Worth was an English fashion designer who founded the House of Worth, one of the foremost fashion houses of the 19th and early 20th centuries. He is considered by many fashion historians to be the father of haute couture. Worth is also credited with revolutionising the business of fashion.
highlights: Founded the House of Worth fashion house.
Considered the father of haute couture.

people.name: John Hervey, 2nd Baron Hervey
people.extract: John Hervey, 2nd Baron Hervey, was an English courtier and political writer. Heir to the Earl of Bristol, he obtained the key patronage of Walpole, and was involved in many court intrigues and literary quarrels, being apparently caricatured by Pope and Fielding. His memoirs of the early reign of George II were too revealing to be published in his time and did not appear for more than a century.
highlights: Authored revealing memoirs of George II's reign.
